name: F-1 Student Visa + Optional Practical Training (OPT)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires full-time enrolment at an SEVP-certified school.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an SEVP-certified institution.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrating sufficient funds to cover tuition and living costs for the program duration.
requirements.fix_path: Arrange sufficient funds or a funding declaration.

evidence_required.document: Form I-20 from the SEVP-certified school

outcome.duration_length: duration of study, plus 12 months standard OPT (36 months total with the STEM OPT extension for STEM-field graduates)

sources.title: Optional Practical Training (OPT) for F-1 Students - USCIS

notes: SEVIS fee CONFIRMED at $350 (not the $540 figure some sources cite, which applies only to terminated/reactivated SEVIS records — a genuine stale-figure risk worth flagging). STEM OPT extension (+24 months) requires an E-Verify employer and a Form I-983 training plan — total possible OPT time 36 months for STEM graduates vs 12 for non-STEM, a real structural fork worth surfacing. Cap-gap provision extends F-1 status and work authorization to the start of the fiscal year (traditionally Oct 1) if a timely, selected H-1B change-of-status petition is filed — a genuine bridge mechanic linking this route directly to us_h1b. GENUINE UPCOMING STRUCTURAL CHANGE, not yet in force: DHS published a final rule July 17, 2026 establishing a fixed period of admission (replacing 'duration of status'/D/S) for F, J, and I nonimmigrants — implementation timeline and mechanics were not fully confirmed during the research pass this was built from; flagged as a live item to re-verify, not yet encoded as a hard change since the effective date wasn't confirmed.
